scenes.title: Visual Fashion Product Search
sentences: Welcome to Visual Fashion Product Search, a graduation project at the International University of Technology Twintech.
The project is developed by Nasser Yousef, Noor Yousef, and Naeem Basalma, supervised by Doctor Ayman Alsabri.

scenes.title: Search by appearance
sentences: Finding clothing with words can be difficult when a user does not know the product name.
Our application accepts an image and retrieves visually similar clothing from a local catalogue.
The original gallery contains three thousand and sixty-eight images across ten clothing categories.

scenes.title: Full-image search
sentences: First, upload a photograph and choose full-image search.
The system prepares the image, extracts a visual representation, and ranks catalogue images by similarity.
A photograph containing several garments may describe the whole scene instead of the item the user intends to find.

scenes.title: Interactive garment selection
sentences: To focus the query, choose intelligent selection and click the intended garment.
Sam two point one generates a mask. Positive and negative points help refine the selection.
Review the cutout before accepting it, then search using the selected garment.
The results show visually similar catalogue items. Similarity scores are not probabilities of an exact commercial-product match.

scenes.title: How the system works
sentences: The browser communicates with a Fast A P I backend.
Sig lip two produces a normalized vector with seven hundred and sixty-eight dimensions.
F A I S S ranks the vectors. Both full images and accepted garment cutouts pass through the same visual encoder.
The models run locally, using a compatible graphics processor when available, with a C P U fallback.

scenes.title: Measured results and their scope
sentences: On one hundred historical synthetic queries containing multiple garments, category correctness at the first result increased from forty-six percent for full images to seventy-five percent after selection.
This is a gain of twenty-nine percentage points.
It measures category relevance under that experiment, rather than general accuracy for identifying the exact commercial product.

scenes.title: Local product management
sentences: A protected local administrator can add, edit, and delete products, with up to five photographs for each product.
Product details include category, optional price and currency, and availability.
Guests can search these added products from the main page without an account.
Backup and restore tools help preserve the added catalogue.

scenes.title: Current scope and next steps
sentences: The current system supports local visual search and product management.
The original image index remains active because cropping catalogue images did not show a sufficient consistent improvement.
The next research priority is a larger set of verified product identities and independent query photographs.

scenes.title: Source code and runtime resources
sentences: The public GitHub repository provides the source code, editable documentation, and instructions for the runtime resources.
Thank you for watching.
